body.h: always keep count. For example chant ‘pass, self, self’ to yourself when waltzing;
don’t pass if you only have two clubs. This is known as passing the gap or holding through
don’t look away. Your partner might pass clubs to you, even if you think the pattern is

It’s useful to give your partner some feedback about their passes. For example, tell them if you’d like more spin on their passes or shorter or higher passes. Maybe hold your hand up and say: ‘I’d like your passes here’. Also encourage them to comment on your passes by asking: ‘are my passes all right?’
